business_problem: Equitable's Employee Benefits team was constrained by a brittle homegrown connector, manual list building, slow HTML email coding, and disconnected sweepstakes tooling that prevented scalable, targeted marketing.
solution_summary: Equitable replaced a fragile homegrown connector and disconnected campaign tooling with a modern marketing stack centered on Agentforce Marketing and Salesforce CRM. The new design uses a secure bidirectional CRM integration as the single source of business data, then lets marketers build target lists in two clicks rather than repeated extracts and uploads. Journey Builder automates scheduled multi-step campaigns, engagement splits, and send-time optimization based on historical behavior, while a 20-plus-block content library gives users reusable approved modules with personalized sales-executive details and UTM parameters. Marketing Cloud Pages replaced external sweepstakes tools so entries prefill from CRM records, duplicates are blocked automatically, and winner notifications run natively. Together, those changes removed five-day coding bottlenecks, reduced IT dependency, and gave the team a platform it can keep extending with evergreen journeys and new meeting-request flows.

solution_components.name: Agentforce Marketing
solution_components.role: Runs Equitable's redesigned campaign framework and content operations.

solution_components.name: Salesforce CRM
solution_components.role: Acts as the authoritative system for audience data, approvals, and downstream tasks.

solution_components.name: Journey Builder
solution_components.role: Automates scheduled multi-step campaigns and engagement-based follow-up paths.

solution_components.name: Marketing Cloud Pages
solution_components.role: Hosts web-based landing pages that write sweepstakes and request data directly back to CRM.

solution_components.name: Send Time Optimization
solution_components.role: Uses engagement history to deliver each email when recipients are most likely to open it.

data_flow: Business data is synchronized bidirectionally with Salesforce CRM, used to create lists and audience segments, then passed into Journey Builder and Marketing Cloud Pages for campaign execution. Engagement behavior feeds Send Time Optimization and follow-up logic, while page submissions and winner notifications write back into CRM workflows.
business_outcome: Equitable sped up campaign production, improved segmentation and compliance control, automated sweepstakes administration, and gave marketers more freedom to launch targeted outreach without waiting on technical intermediaries.
